note: Sean's State Run Checklist v1.1 rules as data, keyed by checklist ID. This is Admin's scorecard and never holds back publishing. The v1.1 profile (lib/control-plane/readiness/checklist-profile.json) is left untouched because its importer rewrites it.

appliesTo.note: A known record only owes its own facts. A matching rule lists the groups or IDs the record owes, less excludeIds. A capture kind with no rule owes every item in its subject kind's groups. Registry bodies owe GOV and PAR, not ENG: ENG measures the app's reactions, privacy, feedback and alert delivery, so it is not an acquisition task per body. Local votes belong to the body's meeting actions, not Congress or state roll calls or federal PRL; a roster can include a mayor, so local officeholders keep EXE. A campaign committee has no public budget and a voting date has no polling location; those stay discovery work for the place, not the record.

freshnessHours.note: Hours a captured field stays fresh, by the kind of source it came from.
